tasks.label: Harmonics: Stop API port
args: $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 4000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($connection in $connections) { Stop-Process -Id $connection.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tasks.label: Harmonics: Stop Web port
args: $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($connection in $connections) { Stop-Process -Id $connection.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
